detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 🦞🎒 # US # Fish and # Wildlife biologists are testing tiny photo-IDs attached as "backpacks" to # endangered Big Sandy # crayfish in # Appalachia . Because injecting a # chip would harm the 10 cm (4 in) # crustaceans , researchers superglue a batter-free PIT tag to each # shell and set it with baking soda water. The setup was first tested on a common surrogate species, and the tags letting go are actually a sign the crayfish survived long enough to molt. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/backpac ks-crayfish-superglue/ # conservation # wildlife # biology # science # endangeredspecies # nature # animals # research # freshwater # water # fieldwork
